name: wallflyer-shield-bump
description: ⛓⛓⛓ seedling-fidelity-wallflyer W7 — THE SHIELD TURNS A WALLFLYER. L22, boot (80,112), the sword and the shield, `left` for 14 ticks into `wallflyer@48,112`'s y-120 ray, then still. The flyer launches at the player (+4 px/t) and on every tick the MOVING player's shield box touches it, `Player.shieldBump` calls `WallFlyer.knockback` — `v = -v`, no gate — so it turns back: the model bills the turn at t 5, 7, 9, 13. Player hits: t 9 wallflyer@48,112. Authored by scripts/procgen/plan-seedling-wallflyer.mjs.
